title: Tokimeki Memorial Drama Series Vol. 3: Tabidachi no Uta
native_title: ときめきメモリアル ドラマ・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．３ ～旅立ちの詩～
overview:
Each One's Feelings, Each One's Graduation, and Then... Setting Out -

Winter of senior year, with graduation just ahead. Just as he vows to confess his feelings to his longtime crush and childhood friend Shiori Fujisaki, the protagonist is shocked to hear her say, "Let's always be good friends." Looking back on his high school life, he realizes he has nothing appealing about himself as he is now. To test himself, he stakes the rest of his high school life on a marathon he took up on a whim...

それぞれの想い、それぞれの卒業、そして……旅立ち――

卒業を目前に控えた3年生の冬。憧れの幼馴染み藤崎詩織への告白を胸に誓った矢先、「いつまでも仲のいい友達でいてね」と言われ、ショックを受ける主人公。高校生活を振り返り、今の自分には何の魅力もないことを悟った主人公は自分を試すため、ちょっとしたきっかけで始めたマラソンに残りの高校生活をかける……。
